title: LLM API pricing dataset
description:
Prices of current large language model APIs as published by their makers, each with the day it was last verified and the maker's page it was read from, plus a dated record of every change to those prices (models.json, models.csv, price-changes.json).

This is the data behind the LLM API pricing table of AI Signal, aisignalhq.com/api-pricing/. How each price is verified, and what that does not guarantee: aisignalhq.com/methodology/. The authoritative source for every price is the maker's page in sourceUrl.
notes: Each GitHub release archived by Zenodo is a snapshot of the files the site published that day. verifiedAt on each row, not the release date, says when its price was last confirmed.
